Tests batch URI extraction with per-input config (extract_batch)

```ruby title="Ruby"

result = Xberg.extract_batch([{ 'config' => { 'output_format' => 'markdown' }, 'kind' => 'uri', 'uri' => 'https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf' }])
result.results.each do |result|
  puts result.content
end
```
